claim.claim-text: 1. A base station apparatus (201) configured to perform measurement gap configuration, the base station apparatus (201) comprising:

baseband circuitry (251) configured to assign, for a user device (211), a measurement gap configuration comprising a first measurement gap and a first offset for a first frequency range FR1 and a second measurement gap and a second offset for a second frequency range FR2, wherein the first frequency range FR1 represents an Long Technology Evolution (LTE) and a low frequency range for new radio (NR), and the second frequency range FR2 represents a high frequency range for NR; and an interface configured to send a frame comprising the measurement gap configuration to the user device (211).

2. The base station apparatus (201) of claim 1, wherein one or both of the first and second measurement gaps are shared for channel state information reference signal (CSI-RS) and new radio synchronization signal (NR-SS) measurements.
3. A user device apparatus (211) configured to perform measurement gap configuration, the user device apparatus (211) comprising:

an interface; and baseband circuitry (261) coupled with the interface and configured to decode downlink data with a measurement gap configuration information, wherein the measurement gap configuration information comprises a first measurement gap and a first offset for a first frequency range FR1 and a second measurement gap and a second offset for a second frequency range FR2, wherein the first frequency range FR1 represents an Long Technology Evolution (LTE) and a low frequency range for new radio (NR), and the second frequency range FR2 represents a high frequency range for NR.

4. The user device apparatus (211) of claim 3, wherein one or both of the first and second measurement gaps are shared for channel state information reference signal (CSI-RS) and new radio synchronization signal (NR-SS) measurements.

5. The user device apparatus (211) of claim 3, wherein a master base station determines and/or transmits the first measurement gap, and wherein a secondary base station determines and/or transmits the second measurement gap.

6. The user device apparatus (211) of claim 3, wherein the baseband circuitry (261) comprises a processor (213) and a memory (203) coupled with the processor (213), the user device apparatus (211) further comprising a radio (218) coupled with a physical layer device of the user device (211), and one or more antennas (231) coupled with the radio (218) to communicate with the user device (211).
7. A method to perform measurement gap configuration, comprising:

receiving, by the baseband circuitry (261), downlink data with measurement gap configuration information, wherein the measurement gap configuration information comprises a first measurement gap and a first offset for a first frequency range FR1 and a second measurement gap and a second offset for a second frequency range FR2, wherein the first frequency range FR1 represents an Long Technology Evolution (LTE) and a low frequency range for new radio (NR), and the second frequency range FR2 represents a high frequency range for NR; and parsing, by the baseband circuitry (261), the measurement gap configuration information to perform measurements using the the first measurement gap or the second measurement gap.

8. The method of claim 7, wherein one or both of the first and second measurement gaps are shared for channel state information reference signal (CSI-RS) and new radio synchronization signal (NR-SS) measurements.

9. A machine-readable medium containing instructions, which when executed by a processor (213) associated with baseband circuitry (261) of a user device (211), cause the processor (213) to perform operations comprising operations to:

decode, by the baseband circuitry (261), downlink data with a measurement gap configuration information, wherein the measurement gap configuration information comprises a first measurement gap and a first offset for a first frequency range FR1 and a second measurement gap and a second offset for a second frequency range FR2, wherein the first frequency range FR1 represents an Long Technology Evolution (LTE) and a low frequency range for new radio (NR), and the second frequency range FR2 represents a high frequency range for NR; and parsing, by the baseband circuitry (261), the measurement gap configuration information to perform measurements using the the first measurement gap or the second measurement gap.

10. The machine-readable medium of claim 9, wherein a master base station determines and/or transmits the first measurement gap, and wherein a secondary base station determines and/or transmits the second measurement gap.
